n_b_input = input().split()
n = int(n_b_input[0])
b = int(n_b_input[1])
array = list(map(int, input().split()))

prefixSum = []
balanceCount = 0
for i in range(n):
    if array[i] % 2 == 0:
        balanceCount += 1
    else:
        balanceCount -= 1
    prefixSum.append(balanceCount)

diffList = []
for i in range(n - 1):
    if prefixSum[i] == 0:
        diffList.append(abs(array[i] - array[i + 1]))

diffList.sort()

totalCuts = 0
accumulated = 0
for diff in diffList:
    if accumulated + diff <= b:
        accumulated += diff
        totalCuts += 1
    if accumulated >= b:
        break

print(totalCuts)
